Tinkering and tinkering. No one understood the machines as much as you did. In fact, no one understood you either. Perhaps it was always meant to be.

Passive
[Passive, In Slot] Tools of the Trade - Nearby Sentries or Dispensers will upgrade passively near the player. The longer it lives, the stronger it gets.
Active
[Active, Held] Build [Sentry/Dispenser]:
Sentry:
Holding down the skill for 5 seconds will see you build a sentry at that location. Sentries are stationary and copy the user’s attributes at the time of building, like armor, HP, SHP and more.
Sentries are autonomous and shoot at the nearest non-friendly target, including players.
Maximum of 2 sentries at a time. Cooldown of 30 seconds. Placing down a new sentry at the limit of 2 will destroy the oldest placed sentry.
Level 2 requires 120 seconds of being near the player. It will double the fire rate of the sentry.
Level 3 requires 300 seconds (total 300, so 5 minutes from level 1) of being near the player. It will increase the fire rate further and equip your sentry with missiles.
Dispenser:
Place down a Dispenser that provides the nearest player with magicules, aura and health over time. It restores 0.5% of MP and Aura every 5 seconds at level one.
At level 2, after 120 seconds of being near the player, it starts to dispense health, healing 10 HP and restoring 1% of MP/AP every 5 seconds.
At level 3, after 300 seconds (total 300, so 5 minutes from level 1) of being near the player, it starts to heal 5% of HP and restore 3% of MP/AP every 3 seconds.
Active: [Active, Press] Bubble Shield - Throw down a bubble shield at the player's feet that lasts for 15 seconds. The bubble shield blocks all damage from the outside and prevents entities and projectiles from entering it. The owner and allies of the owner may enter or leave as they see fit. Puts the skill on a 25 second cooldown.

Wield the authority of kings and command treasures beyond mortal reach. Summon divine armaments from the vault, binding foes in chains of judgment while asserting dominion over all.

Information
Source: Mysticism
Type: Unique Skill
Obtain Cost: 85,000 MP
Points to Master: 1000
Passive: In Slot

Obtaining
Reincarnation / Reroll.

Passive
[Passive, In Slot] Golden Rule: Grants a permanent Luck V effect while the skill is in a slot.

Active
[Active, Press] Enkidu: Costs 25,000 MP to imprison the target the user is looking at in holy chains, sealing all movement and skill usage. Lasts 120 seconds, increased to 240 seconds when mastered. Cooldown: 20 seconds, reduced to 10 seconds when mastered. Missing also incurs the cooldown.

[Active, Press] King's Storehouse: Opens a Spatial Storage with the dimensions of a large chest featuring 5 weapon slots, increased to 10 when mastered. Only weapons can be stored, with each item placed individually without stacking. This storehouse supplies the arsenal for Gates of Babylon.

[Active, Held] Gates of Babylon: Summons the arsenal deposited in the storehouse and fires at the location the user is looking at. There is a fixed cooldown of 5 seconds between uses.
The number of portals scales with skill mastery:
0 mastery: 1 portal.
250 mastery: 2 portals.
500 mastery: 3 portals.
750 mastery: 4 portals.
1000 mastery: 5 portals.

Crouching while using the skill causes the portals to surround the targeted location. If an entity is targeted, the portals automatically aim and fire arrows of light that deal Spatial Damage.
Portal counts while crouching:
0 mastery: 3 portals.
250 mastery: 4 portals.
500 mastery: 5 portals.
750 mastery: 6 portals.
Mastered: 7 portals.

Information
Source: Mysticism
Type: Unique Skill
Obtain Cost: 95,000 MP
Points to Master: 1000
Passive: Toggle

Obtaining
Reincarnation / Reroll.

Passive
[Passive, Toggle] Tailed Beast Host: Increases the amount of permanent EP gained when killing entities from 3% to 9%, or 14% when mastered.

Active
[Active, Held] Tailed Beast Bomb: Creates a ball of MP and AP. Each 1.0 charge costs 800 MP and 200 AP. Maximum charge is 100.0, increased to 150.0 when mastered. Deals 30 damage per 5.0 charge. When charged past 3.0, it explodes on impact, dealing 150 damage in the impact area; every 10.0 charge increases the impact radius by 2. Charge increases by 1.0 each second, or every 0.50 seconds when mastered.

[Active, Press] Tailed Beast Cloak: Releases the beast within at great risk to the user. Initially, the user loses control until this mode has been used enough to master it.

Forms (based on Tailed Beast Cloak use count)
Initial Jinchuriki State (10 uses or fewer):
Fully restores health and grants a Strength III-equivalent damage increase, 5 armor points, and +0.04 Movement Speed. Temporarily increases maximum MP and AP to 1.5x. The user loses control and attacks wildly for 30 seconds.

Version 1 Cloak (more than 10, fewer than 100 uses):
Fully restores health and rapidly recovers MP. Grants a Strength V-equivalent damage increase, 10 armor points, and +0.08 Movement Speed. Grants Regeneration II while active and temporarily increases maximum MP and AP to 1.7x. The user loses control and attacks wildly for 30 seconds.

Version 2 Cloak (more than 100, fewer than 250 uses):
Fully restores health and rapidly recovers MP. Grants a Strength X-equivalent damage increase, 15 armor points, and +0.12 Movement Speed. Grants Regeneration V while active and temporarily increases maximum MP and AP to 2x. The user loses control and attacks wildly for 30 seconds.

Controlled State (more than 250, fewer than 1000 uses):
Fully restores health and rapidly recovers MP. Grants a Strength XII-equivalent damage increase, 20 armor points, and +0.15 Movement Speed. Grants Regeneration VII while active and temporarily increases maximum MP and AP to 2.2x.

Perfect Controlled State (more than 1000 uses):
Fully restores health and rapidly recovers MP. Grants a Strength XV-equivalent damage increase, 25 armor points, and +0.18 Movement Speed. Grants Regeneration IX while active and temporarily increases maximum MP and AP to 2.5x.

Your demonic prowess allows you to enter Hell at will, creating a portal between both dimensions and instantly warping to the other side.

Active
[Active, Press] Warp (Overworld) - Teleports the user to the overworld. Doesn't work if you're in the overworld.
Active: [Active, Press] Warp (Hell) - Teleports the user to Hell. Doesn't work if you're in Hell.
Skill has cooldown of 600 seconds, 300 upon mastery.

W.I.P

Passive
[Passive, Toggle] Damage Redirection - Any magic damage taken by the user is countered fully. (double the damage on mastery)
Passive: [Passive, True, requires Mastery] Destiny Switch - When User takes damage below 25% swaps their place with the farthest mob in a 40 block radius.
Active
[Active, Press] Malice Exchange: Takes your or an entities debuffs and lets you put it onto other entities.
Active: [Active, Press] Redirect - Lets you swap the places of yourself with a different entity.

Boost the power of Light and Heat abilities by a great amount.

Passive
[Passive, Toggle] Boost - increases damage dealt by fire and light attack x8 (does not stack with flame manipulation/domination and light manipulation/domination).
Active
[Active - Hold] Black Flame Breath: Breathe black flames that do 10 damage per second (20 when mastered). Cost 50 MP per second.

Blend the shadows together for a perfect mix of discord and harmony. Rule over them and destroy all who dare to disrupt the Shadow Monarch's reign.

Passive
[Passive, Toggle] Soulscape - Killing any entity will have a 25% chance for their soul to linger for a short period of time. 50% chance on mastery. The user has 30 seconds to choose whether or not to keep this entity or it will disappear forever. See [Shadow Warrior].
Passive: [Passive, True] Essence of Night - During the night, your shadows grow restless. All Shadow Warriors gain increased damage and speed. Does not affect the player, unless a specific condition is met. See [Shadow Merge].
Active
[Active, Press] Shadow Warrior - Pressing the mode while looking at a lingering soul will create a Shadow Warrior version of the mob you killed, at the cost of the target's EP before you killed them PERMANENTLY. This REDUCES YOUR MAX MP BY THE TARGET'S EP. Includes Otherworlders but not bosses. Shadow Warriors are loyal to the player and act like a permanent subordinate.
Active: [Active, Press] Shadow Storage - Store any subordinate you are looking at into an item. Right click the ground to re-summon them.
Active: [Active, Press] Shadow Merge - While holding any of your shadow warrior subordinates in item form, pressing the skill key will allow you to harness their abilities, meaning their stats are added onto yours. Their max EP is added to your EP while Merge is happening. Pressing Shadow Merge again while merged will give you the original subordinate back in item form. Dying will make you permanently lose this subordinate.
While Merged, Essence of Night applies to you as well.
Special Interaction
Mastering plunderer makes shadow motion available to the user

Unusable if you are not a Queen Wasp or it's subsequent evolutions.

Passive: [Passive, Toggle] Probability Manipulation - 50% dodge 45% crit (70% dodge on mastery) (65% crit on mastery)
Passive: [Passive, Toggle] The Balance - All crit damage agasint the damage is countered and carries over all buffs (i.e: cook users will cook themselves, target will sever themselves if they had severence.)
